confirmed_blockers: The broad project typecheck admitted unbound workspace/package inputs and did not isolate or necessarily include the candidate overlay.
The verifier did not enforce exactly numberStart: Parser<boolean>; number, any, and Parser<any> were not excluded by the advertised candidate gate.
The running verifier bytes were not linked to the exact sealed manifest row.

generation_7_repairs.isolated_program: The exact candidate and an in-memory verifier probe are the only compiler roots. Explicit strict ES2022/ESNext/Bundler/noEmit/types=[] options replace project tsc. Every resolved SourceFile must be the candidate, probe, or a byte-bound member of the 130-file TypeScript package or 64-file parse-that dist; every input is hashed and emitted.
generation_7_repairs.exact_type: The probe rejects root/payload any and unknown and requires bidirectional exactness for both typeof numberStart ↔ Parser<boolean> and inferred payload ↔ boolean. TypeScript module inspection separately requires one exact direct numberStart export and emits the observed type receipt.
generation_7_repairs.manifest_anchor: The invocation supplies the externally recorded owner-sealed G7 manifest SHA-256. The canonical verifier hashes adjacent manifest.json to that digest, reads exactly one own row, reproduces its running bytes against that row, and emits both identities.
generation_7_repairs.nonconformant_digest: A different caller-supplied digest is not a G7 gate invocation even if it describes other bytes. Candidate receipts must bind the one owner-sealed digest recorded after the fresh holdout joins this precursor.
generation_7_repairs.mechanical_nonclaims: The repaired type/identity mechanisms still grant no semantic, idiom, scanner, architecture, O(1), KISS, or performance credit. All five exact-source skeptics retain every such axis.

grammar_contract.input: An ordinary parse-that child ParserState at a source-native UTF-16 offset corresponding to one retained CSS-preprocessed position or EOF.
grammar_contract.operation: Inspect no more than the next three CSS input positions through direct parse-that terminals/combinators. Return true exactly for digit, sign+digit, dot+digit, or sign+dot+digit; otherwise false.
grammar_contract.composition: Both binding lanes run: direct candidate.parser(state), and string(prefix).map(predecessor).next(candidate).skip(string(continuation)).
grammar_contract.state_identity: Raw child and outer parent each return the identical ParserState object received.
grammar_contract.source_identity: Preserve ParserState.src own-property presence and exact string value/identity.
grammar_contract.predecessor: Replace any predecessor with the boolean result without depending on predecessor content. Seven representatives cover package-default undefined, null, false, 0, empty string, frozen array, and frozen object; this evidence is not an enumeration of JavaScript values.
grammar_contract.consumption: Always succeed, consume zero UTF-16 code units, and leave the following grammar at the candidate offset.
grammar_contract.diagnostics: In explicit package disabled/enabled modes, preserve furthest, expected own-property/reference/ordered values, suggestions array and entry identities/fields, secondarySpans array and entry identities/fields, and global diagnostics mode.
diagnostic_profiles: undefined expected with multiple diagnostics before
grammar_contract.diagnostic_sandbox: A candidate-local Parser wrapper may snapshot/restore only parser and diagnostic bookkeeping around direct core-combinator recognition. Its work is candidate cost. It may not import diagnostics, change global mode, inspect/derive state.src, classify source manually, advance an imperative cursor, or feed a token/CST layer.
grammar_contract.preprocessing: ASCII +, -, ., and digits survive filtering. Assert raw/preprocessed truth only at mapped retained positions/EOF; never supply an eliminated CRLF interior.
grammar_contract.work_bound: Worst-case O(1) time/space; at most three positions; no whole-number/exponent run, source materialization, token/CST, imperative loop/scanner, or broad remainder capture.

fixture_identity.fresh_holdout_law: A wholly fresh G7 custodian binds these immutable precursor bytes and all public closure identities. No G4/G5/G6 hidden byte may be recovered, inferred, revealed, or reused.

seats.topology: Bounded first-three explicit core-combinator branches; never whole-number/exponent recognition.
Bounded prefix productions; no f64 conversion or whole numeric run.
Normative alternatives as an explicit production tree.
First-character dispatch/chain, not production-tree or single-regex clone.
One bounded zero-width terminal expression plus always-successful fallback and diagnostic sandbox.

candidate_generation.lineage_accounting: H/B/S may converge on one branch lineage; D and R remain independently constrained. Five isolated authors must yield at least three material lineages or return to formation.
candidate_generation.isolation: No author sees another candidate, hidden bytes/results, or cross-seat design notes before all five source, overlay, projected, isolated-program, and type identities close.
candidate_generation.candidate_source_gate: No candidate source exists before one G7 manifest binds this precursor and a wholly fresh G7 holdout receipt, two independent exact-byte boundary challenges ACCEPT, and root gestalt ACCEPTS.

post_candidate_adjudication.quintet: Five independent skeptics each review every exact candidate on correctness, spec, state/diagnostics, predecessor independence, exact type/identity, idiomatic parse-that, anti-scanner/source policy, modular ownership, LOC/KISS, work bound, and performance. No axis is partitioned away.
post_candidate_adjudication.triumvirate: Three independent adjudicators then nominate an already-reviewed exact candidate or explicit composition; a new opaque implementation restarts candidate generation.
post_candidate_adjudication.integration: Only the converged exact overlay may enter the empty active base; full-ledger incompleteness still withholds feature apotheosis.
